sezioni.heading: DTF printing or embroidery: how to choose
paragrafi: These are the two techniques we use most often. The right choice depends on the garment, the artwork, the quantity and the effect you want to achieve.

DTF (Direct to Film) printing reproduces detailed graphics and vivid colors on any fabric, holds up well to washing and is the most cost-effective option for large quantities. It's ideal for t-shirts, hoodies, promotional shirts and merchandising.

Embroidery stitches your logo in thread: it gives an elegant, three-dimensional and highly durable result, perfect for polos, jackets and uniforms exposed to frequent or high-temperature washing. It works best with simple logos and text, and less so with photographic images.

faq.domanda: Is DTF printing or embroidery better?
faq.risposta: It depends on the use. DTF printing is perfect for detailed graphics, vivid colors and large quantities. Embroidery is more elegant and durable, ideal for polos, jackets and workwear.

faq.domanda: What is the minimum quantity to personalize clothing?
faq.risposta: We handle both large orders for an entire company and small runs for events, teams or private occasions. We'll suggest the solution best suited to the quantity you need.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to personalize corporate clothing?
faq.risposta: The price depends on quantity, garment type and technique. DTF printing is more cost-effective for large quantities, while embroidery suits small premium runs. Get in touch for a free quote.

faq.domanda: Which garments can I personalize with my logo?
faq.risposta: T-shirts, polos, shirts, hoodies, jackets, caps and technical workwear. We'll help you choose the right garment based on your industry and the season.
Yes. Both DTF printing and embroidery are made to last and to withstand frequent washing. Embroidery also holds up well to the high temperatures used for workwear.
